note: Adapted from the genus-level account in Roonwal & Chhotani (1989) (in English), whose description is adapted from Bose's 1984 original description; the soldier and pseudoworker are described and measured, and the original gives the alate as Imago Unknown. The type specimen was examined; the type locality is Salem, Tamil Nadu, India, the species being known from the type locality only.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule red-brown, paler behind; postclypeus and labrum slightly darker; anteclypeus transparent; mandibles chestnut-brown with a bright red-brown base; antennae pale golden brown, segment 3 dark and strongly sclerotized; thorax, legs and body creamy yellow. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length 11.3 mm. Head capsule almost rectangular, one and a half times as long as wide (length to the base of the mandibles 3.30 mm, width 2.20 mm); sides rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight and slightly incurved; Y suture prominent; frons sloping at about 45° in front. Compound eyes large and translucent (length 0.30 mm), about half an eye length (0.20 mm) behind the antennae. Ocelli small, whitish and dot-like, situated at the ends of the lateral arms of the Y suture. Postclypeus flat and almost rectangular, indistinctly differentiated from the frons; with a pair of short hairs on either side. Anteclypeus hairless, transparent and band-like. Labrum short and broad, the tip rounded, with long and short bristles on the anterior margin and surface. Antennae more than 13-segmented; segment 3 strongly sclerotized, about one and a half times as long as segment 2; segments 4 and 5 about equal and shorter than segment 2; segments 6—11 gradually increasing; segments 12 and 13 more slender than the preceding ones. Mandibles short and thick (length 1.80 mm), the tip weakly incurved and slightly more than half the head length (mandible length/head length index 0.54), the outer margin moderately raised at the basal third. Left mandible with 7 and right mandible with 2 marginal teeth. Postmentum long and clavate; the club bilobed, the anterior lobe slightly narrower than the posterior lobe; the stalk long and narrow, the waist width about one third of the greatest width (length 2.55 mm, greatest width of the posterior lobe 0.88 mm, waist width 0.30 mm). Pronotum flat and slightly wider than the head capsule, far wider than long (length 1.30 mm, greatest width 2.28 mm); margins and surface with a few long and short bristles; anterior margin shallowly incurved; sides weakly rounded; posterior margin nearly straight and slightly incurved in the middle. Meso- and metanota semicircular, the sides nearly straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head capsule pale creamy yellow; antennae, legs and body pale creamy white; clypeus and labrum pale brown; mandibles pale brown with an almost blackish brown tooth area. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 8.40 mm. Head capsule almost circular, slightly wider than long (length to the base of the mandibles 1.73 mm, greatest width 1.88 mm). Compound eyes large and oval, length 0.23 mm. Antennae 16-segmented, segment 4 the shortest. Postclypeus flat, with 2—3 bristles on either side; anteclypeus narrow, hairless and flat. Labrum broad and tongue-shaped, with several long and short hairs on the surface. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum flat and wider than long (length 1.03 mm, greatest width 2.03 mm); anterior margin weakly concave; posterior margin slightly convex. Legs short and hairy; apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate-oval and creamy white; cerci 2-segmented, length 0.15 mm; styli single-segmented, length 0.19 mm.
